name: comonetso
description: Claude Code plugins from the Claude State Bar project.

plugins.name: codex-rescue
plugins.description: Get a second opinion from the Codex CLI: consult, review, edit, or chat.

plugins.name: peer-req
plugins.description: Let open Claude Code sessions ask and notify each other across repositories and machines over Remote Control, with IDs, acknowledgements and records.

plugins.name: browser-check
plugins.description: Let Claude look at, click through and diagnose your real browser (Aside/Chromium) from a server or the PC, behind a policy layer.
